def feed(db, limit=20):
    posts = db.posts.latest(limit)
    result = []
    for post in posts:
        author = db.users.get(post.author_id)
        result.append({**post.to_dict(), 'author': author.name})
    return result

ground_truth.rationale: One user query per post (N+1); fetch authors in one batched query.
